facts.business: Uday Jewellery Industries Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and retailing of jewellery, with a heritage dating back to 1905, supplying to the Nizam of Hyderabad and operating retail stores in Hyderabad.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to large number of sales contracts with varied contractual terms in jewellery business
Credit risk from trade receivables with significant past due amounts (Rs 13,390.65 lakhs as at March 31, 2026)
Liquidity risk managed through committed credit lines and internal accruals
facts.related_party_note: Related parties include Sanghi Jewellers Private Limited (entity on which KMP have significant influence/control) and Pritha Sanghi (relative of Key Management Personnel).
